dogecoin.text:
Rollercoasters can be fun rides.
Except when you’re on the crypto one, it’s not just you going up and down crazily, it’s your wealth doing so. 
#Dogecoin

Surprised at how MFs are restricted to say anything about the promise of performance on mutual fund schemes, and we have crypto folks literally luring gullible investors basis how spectacular the Dogecoin run has been! Shouldn’t SEBI be controlling their Comms too?
